repos_data.description: The HTML5 Creation Engine: Create beautiful digital content with the fastest, most flexible 2D WebGL renderer.

A graph node engine and editor written in Javascript similar to PD or UDK Blueprints, comes with its own editor in HTML5 Canvas2D. The engine can run client side or server side using Node. It allows to export graphs as JSONs to be included in applications independently.
React-based framework with performance, scalability, and security built in.
A multi-platform library for OpenGL, OpenGL ES, Vulkan, window and input
